en: A standard metal zipper works by using two tiny wedge-shaped inclined planes to force the interlocking teeth together.
Ice skates glide smoothly because the narrow blade melts the ice into a thin, slippery layer of water.
Because Jupiter has much more mass than Earth, a person weighing 100 pounds here would weigh about 253 pounds there.
You can permanently demagnetize an iron magnet by heating it to 770 degrees Celsius, which is known as its Curie temperature.
The static electricity generated by rubbing a balloon on your hair can reach voltages as high as 10,000 volts.
Light travels so incredibly fast that it can circle the Earth's equator about seven and a half times in just one second.
Sound travels about seventeen times faster through solid steel than through air, allowing you to hear an approaching train through the tracks first.
The core of our Sun is so intensely hot that it reaches about 15 million degrees Celsius to fuse hydrogen atoms.
The chemical energy stored in a single roasted peanut is enough to theoretically raise the temperature of one liter of water by nearly ten degrees Celsius.
A standard metal screw is actually an inclined plane wrapped around a cylinder, which converts rotational force into strong linear pressure.
The dimples on a golf ball reduce air resistance, allowing it to fly almost twice as far as a perfectly smooth ball.
Astronauts on the International Space Station experience weightlessness not because there is zero gravity, but because they are continuously falling around the Earth.
